body.name: Degeneracy-aware semialgebraic certificate
body.construction: For fixed rational observed summaries and rational finite budgets, \(\mathsf{CERT}\) splits each objective by the signs of \(\pi_x-w_{a,x}\) and by \(\Gamma_a=1\); evaluates the two exposure-odds boundary arcs, their endpoints, and the constant-\(U\) corners; adjoins the legal quadratic-root variables; saturates stationary ideals by every cleared denominator and branch-boundary polynomial; isolates generic interior roots by bivariate resultants and Sturm sequences; validates each isolated candidate by rational interval Newton tests and the original inequalities; and invokes cylindrical algebraic decomposition whenever a resultant vanishes identically or the stationary ideal is positive-dimensional.  For that fixed input it returns real-algebraic endpoint values, rational isolating intervals, and exact membership certificates; it does not return a symbolic atlas over varying inputs.
